outcome: Operator stopped the print after the lower section tipped.

contact_sheet.order: Left to right, top to bottom.

observation: The foreground Y-shaped tree lifts clear of its brim during the toolhead pass and then drops back. The right-hand tip section subsequently rises and rolls onto its side. The head continues over the opening and strands span the displaced section and the material still standing.
limit: The toolhead housing obscures the exact contact point. The footage identifies elapsed time within the recording.
interpretation: The branch moves with the toolhead as the foot lifts, consistent with the toolhead snagging the tree.
